product_one_liner.value: Alice provides AI testing, runtime guardrails and monitoring for organizations building generative-AI applications, agents and foundation models, protecting their systems against attacks, unsafe outputs and policy violations.

pricing_page.notes: No official pricing page or pricing link was found; the site directs visitors to book a demo, and TrustRadius lists no pricing plans.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in the page's Customers section.

eng_blog.notes: Engineering posts cover its data-lake architecture and contextual data model, authored by Principal Engineer Jonathan Lavon and Platform Engineering Manager Noam Levy.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes WonderSuite and content-moderation guides, API documentation, integrations and multiple setup articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Principal Data Scientist in Ramat Gan is listed among current openings.

model_provider.value: ActiveFence AI, its proprietary transformer model powering WonderFence.

compliance_certs.notes: The site states SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certification and displays a HIPAA Compliant badge; HIPAA is a compliance claim rather than a formal certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced August 25, 2026, led by Apax Digital. Dealroom identifies the round as Series D.

raised_18mo.notes: The $140 million round was announced August 25, 2026, within the requested window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A standalone Sales Development Representative posting in San Francisco has Apply Now and an application form, although it is absent from the current careers index.

launched_6mo.notes: An October 12, 2026 announcement introduced WonderFence as a Databricks Unity AI Gateway External Policy for screening prompts, responses and tool calls.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Yossi Mizrahi's profile lists his VP GenAI role at Alice as starting in April 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The SDR posting names these as examples of relevant CRM and sales-engagement experience, not as confirmed deployed systems.
